**Daily Briefing - June 7, 2026**

Yesterday was a smart rest day with 10,803 steps and solid calorie burn of 2,377. Your sleep at 6.6 hours wasn't optimal, but your stress stayed beautifully low at 22/100, showing you're managing recovery well outside of training.

Your HRV sits perfectly within baseline at 114ms and that 44 bpm resting heart rate confirms excellent cardiovascular recovery. However, Karl, your TSB of -23 screams high fatigue—your body absorbed serious training load recently and needs respect. The numbers don't lie about accumulated stress.

Today calls for protection mode. With fatigue this elevated in Phase 1, skip any planned intensity and opt for an easy 30-40 minute jog if you feel genuinely fresh, or take another complete rest day. Your aerobic base builds through consistency, not by pushing through warning signals. Trust the process over the urge to push.

Chester Marathon success lives in these micro-decisions. Elite marathoners know that fitness grows during recovery, not just during hard sessions. You're 126 days out with 19 weeks ahead—plenty of runway. Honor what your body's telling you today, and you'll be stronger for next week's work. Smart training trumps tough training every time.
